objective: Gate-specific seconds adjustment for reference-condition record display, not Top3 or forecast accuracy. Prior gate time associations already known; retrospective corroboration.
source: Preserved quality-view extraction, official horse ID, exact-distance T-minus-2 last-five history; no new external collection or DB writes.
population: Normal complete results positive final times, exactly10 runners numbered1..10; no time-based outcome deletion. Other field sizes support only, not extrapolated.
reference: Uniform mean of10 number effects zero separately per distance; adjustment=-effect. Number proxy for physical gate; actual running path not measured.
primary: Distance-specific same-race and same-horse fixed effects jointly absorbed by exact sparse projection. Standardized prior last-five mean/last exact-distance time, log observed distance starts/all starts/rest gap, event raw age/age squared, carried weight and missing indicators, sex contrasts. Ridgealpha1 on nuisance only, no penalty on9 gate dummies. Gate reference10, reported effects mean-centered over1..10. Train-only preprocessing for each period. No same-race postrace intermediates as covariates.
sensitivity: Full/recent race-only same nuisance; full/recent race+horse with no historical record covariates (other weight/age/experience/gap controls retained). No favorable-specification selection.
support: Estimate>=30 races20dates, residual degrees of freedom>20 and9gate directions identifiable after fixed effects. Candidate corroboration full>=100races40dates2years and confirmation>=100races40dates2years; sparse distances retain NULL/status. Full and recent overlap and are not independent evidence.
inference: Date and horse clustered sandwich with absorbed FE rank degrees-of-freedom adjustment; combined conservative covariance=date covariance+horse covariance (overlapping intersection not subtracted). t critical with min date/horse clusters minus1. Both component intervals preserved. BH separate number family and3pairwise lateral contrasts family, each period/variant. Same horse repeated cluster, still assumptions on long-period form and cross-horse/date dependence.
validation: Freeze2017..2023 gate vector, evaluate fixed rates0,25,50,75,100% against independently fitted2024..2025 residual gate vector. RMS across10 gate effects is condition-bias proxy, not true counterfactual error. Draw2000 normal approximations from held gate covariance with fixed past vector; compare RMS changes. No rate selected or operational adoption.2026 separate if support, otherwise NULL.
candidate: Display100% fitted adjustment and uncertainty as descriptive only. Cell corroborated only if full/confirmation have same sign, both BH q<.05, support passes, all four full/recent sensitivity point signs agree with primary full and recent. Even corroborated cells not automatically fixed-rate adopted. All cells including rejected retained; no arbitrary small-step addition derived from Top3 percentage points.
verification: Input and DB hashes; exclusion policy; source keys; last-five exact horse/distance T-minus-2; FE rank/projection orthogonality; gate meanzero; independent augmented sparse least squares; covariance and interval arithmetic; historical features unchanged; all outputs with sizes.
